home.title: Intent in. Systems out.
home.description: An open-source JVM platform for Java 25: describe the domain in annotated Java, get the handlers, API and front end generated at build time, and run them on a Spring-free kernel.

start.title: Get started
start.description: Generate an Exeris application with the initializr from Maven Central: a Maven backend and an Angular front end from one command.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: The Exeris platform in three tiers: the kernel substrate, composable capabilities and SKUs, and the Wall that keeps Spring out of the kernel.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: The Exeris capability matrix by layer and licence, generated from the capability licence registry.

skus.title: SKUs
skus.description: Exeris SKUs: signed compositions of capabilities in the Gateway and Service Boundary families.

sku-api-gateway.title: API Gateway
sku-api-gateway.description: The Exeris API Gateway SKU: its composition of capabilities, the kernel driver swap and its deployment shapes.

sku-idp.title: IDP
sku-idp.description: The Exeris Intelligent Document Processing SKU: pipeline, composition and the AI abstraction layer.

sku-bot-blocker.title: Bot Blocker
sku-bot-blocker.description: The Exeris Bot Blocker SKU: JA3/JA4 TLS fingerprinting at the kernel layer, and why it is the one closed-source SKU.

spring.title: Spring Runtime
spring.description: Exeris Spring Runtime hosts existing Spring applications on the Exeris kernel in Pure Mode or Compatibility Mode.

ai.title: AI
ai.description: The Exeris AI layer: intent in, systems out. What exists today, what is planned, and how AI works on the platform.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Exeris has no prices yet: it is looking for design partners, and Code Detachment applies to the commercial caps and SKUs.

docs.title: Docs
docs.description: An index of the Exeris documentation: whitepapers, architecture, ADRs, SDK, tooling and benchmark methodology.

lab.title: Lab
lab.description: The Exeris benchmark laboratory: registered claims with their fences, cold start, CPU per request, memory, Spring hosting and sagas.
